welcome.title: Welcome to Design Lab!
welcome.description: Let's take a quick tour of the platform's main features.
features: Practice System Design with real challenges

challenges.title: System Design Challenges
challenges.description: Find real architecture problems to solve. Pick a challenge, design your solution on the virtual whiteboard, and get detailed AI feedback.

forum.title: Forum & Gamification
forum.description: Connect with the community! Create topics, ask questions, and share knowledge. Earn tokens for contributions and climb the leaderboard.

quizzes.title: Interactive Quizzes
quizzes.description: Test and reinforce your System Design knowledge with timed quizzes. Compare your performance on the leaderboard and track your progress.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: Each challenge follows a structured flow: requirements analysis, architecture design, and automatic feedback. That's how you improve!

ready.title: You're all set!
ready.description: You now know the main features. Start by exploring a challenge or browse the forum to meet the community.
